text: Radiant Artificer (Japanese: , Reidianto Cheisā) is a Chain Art in . It is Masha's Chain Art during a Chain Attack.
The Ragrinar Passage (Japanese: , Ragurina Ōdōri) is a location in , located under the Gaur Viaduct on the Aurora Shelf.

The Prototype Automaton is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a Levnis, and is fought at level 22 on the Ruined Anti-Air Battery 3 in Yesterdale during The Running Automaton. It is the prototype for the Automaton Sentries seen used by the Lost Numbers in .
Pruning Woods are Wood Collectibles in . They can be found in Vermilion Woods.
Radicalized Godwin (Japanese: , Kagekina Godowin) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Igna family, and can be found at level 43 in the Exile Fortress Ruins on the Aurora Shelf.
The Radio is a background element that is seen towards the climax of . While Na'el and Matthew are talking in The Ark's memory stage that was created by Ontos, this radio plays in the background.

Quiet Intrigue is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track thirteen of disc two from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track thirteen of disc thirteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the following moments: * When the soldiers of Colony 9, under the influence of B, learn that Noah, Lanz, and Eunie are approaching. * When Shania retrieves Guernica Vandham's eyepatch once the party departs for Millick Meadows at the end of Chapter 1. * The discussion between the Consuls at the beginning of Chapter 2. * When Ethel looks over the Eagus Wilderness while under K's influence. * When the party thinks about the roles of the Consuls and
Prosperous Pippitos are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family that can be found during the Archsage's Gauntlet during the Lucky Monster event.
Prosperous Ottils are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Ottil family that can be found during the Archsage's Gauntlet during the Lucky Monster event.
Quartz Fal-swos are enemies in . They are Fal-swo machines, and can be found in Volitaris.
The Prone Officer is a Story Exclusive Enemy in . It is a member of the Prone family that is fought at level 52 at Mesa Fortress in Oblivia during Chapter 13 (Act 2).

Red Antols are enemies in . They are the more aggressive members of the Antol family. While more aggressive, they are not that different from Yellow Antols. They can be found at level 17 on the Splintered Path in Colony 6 before the events at Mechonis Core.

Rainbow Bugs (Japanese: , Nijiirotagame) are collectables in . They can be found in Frontier Village. According to their description, they shine in myriad colours as they swim and they probably lure small fish.
Rayon Pikes (Japanese: , Reonpaiku) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are gunlances wielded by Reyn. It can only be obtained as a quest reward.

Rasha (Japanese: ) is a Nopon in . She can be found in the Central Plaza of Frontier Village, first lying on the southeast border of Sacred Altar's pool then at the Armour Shop. She is Cherri's aunt. It is revealed in Avenge a Mamapon's Death that she had a sister that was killed during her days as a Nopon Merchant.

Rainbow Zirconias (Japanese: , Nijiiro Kyūbikku) are collectables in . They can be found in Colony 9 and later in Colony 6. According to their description, Reyn had a bit of difficulty naming them and they reflect light like a pretty rainbow. Two are needed for Collection Quest 3 in Colony 9, and three more are required for Colony 6 reconstruction. In , they can be purchased from the Nopon Archsage in Time Attack for 3,900 Noponstones.

Ready Coils (Japanese: , Redi Koiru) are collectables in . They can be found in the Ether Mine. According to their description, they are coils wound with red wire and a fun gadget can be made with them. Two are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In , they can be purchased in Time Attack place from Nopon Archsage for 6,600 Noponstones.
Raoul (Japanese: , Ruhioru) is a Homs in . He can be found in the southern portion of the Military District of Colony 9.

Red Frontiers (Japanese: , Reddo Furontia) are collectables in . They can be found in Sword Valley and Colony 6. According to their description, Sharla looked wild when she named them and they are weird red bricks that are tougher than iron. Two are required for the Colony 6 Reconstruction. In the , they can be purchased in Time Attack place from Nopon Archsage for 27,600 Noponstones.

Rainbow Slugs (Japanese: , Nanaironamako) are collectables in . They can be found on the Fallen Arm. According to their description, they are slugs that stick crystals to their bodies which give them a rugged look. Two are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In , they can be purchased from Time Attack from the Nopon Archsage for 23,700 Noponstones.

Red Lettuce (Japanese: , Akairo Retasu) are collectables in . They can be found in Colony 9 and Colony 6. According to their description, they are particularly spicy lettuce that kids are keen to avoid.
Rakzet (Japanese: , Rei) is a Machina in . He can be found near the connected land southwest of the Junks in the Hidden Machina Village from 00:00 to 21:00.

Refined Parts L are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Mechon in Galahad Fortress or in Fallen Arm, or traded for with Natalia. According to their description, they are pretty parts that are fun to just look at and they make great ornaments. Refined Parts M and Refined Parts S share this description. Ten are required for Broken Ether Furnace.

Refined Parts M are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various Mechon in Galahad Fortress and the Fallen Arm, or traded for with Mixik. According to their description, they are pretty parts that are fun to just look at and they make great ornaments. Refined Parts L and Refined Parts S share this description. Five are required for Restoring the Capital 2.

Red Durians (Japanese: , Reddo Dorian) are collectables in . They can be found on Bionis' Leg. According to their description, they are strong fruit that make someone sweat and they are used as a cold remedy for kids. Two are required for Chemist's Reopening.

The Refugee Camp (Japanese: , Dasshutsu-tei Kyanpu) is a landmark in . It is located on Bionis' Leg. The refugees of Colony 6 flee here when Colony 6 is attacked by the Mechon. It is here that Shulk and Reyn meet Sharla and Juju. There are also many refugees around who give quests, a shop and two Heart-to-Hearts - "Heir to the Monado" and "What's On Reyn's Mind". In the , a Time Attack portal can be found outside the camp.

Razor Teasels (Japanese: , Suirushīta) are collectables in . They can be found in the Eryth Sea. According to their description, they emit exotic sounds and can put someone in a really good mood. Four are required for Betty's Gift.
Ranger Caps (Japanese: , Renjā Kyappu) are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained by completing Education-Crazy Suzanna.

Reckless Godwin (Japanese: , Mubōna Godowin) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Igna family, and can be found at level 31 in the Exile Fortress in Satorl Marsh. It is attended by its Igna soldiers. It can drop an Igna Stone Pot, which is needed for Nopon Determination. Reckless Godwin is very difficult to defeat if fought alongside them without any preparations. It is recommended to lure the soldiers out and kill them first before engaging Reckless Godwin. Even when fought alone, Godwin can still be a difficult fight, particularly if the party has a lower level. The Reckless Godwin is perhaps the first fight that requires tactics, careful timing, and use of ar
Ranger Gloves are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained as a quest reward after completing Arachno Silk Fundraising.

The Reconstruction HQ (Japanese: , Koroni 6 Fukkō Honbu) is a landmark in . It is located in the dome portion of Colony 6. Juju is found here, and it is where the various parts of the Colony can be upgraded.
Ranger Tops are light torso armour in . They can be obtained from enemies in Colony 9, on Kneecap Hill outside of Tephra Cave, and on Bionis' Leg.

Raw Piranhax Meats are rare materials in . They can only be dropped by Colony Piranhax in Colony 9, or traded for with Arnaut. According to their description, they stink though they are not rotten, but to the tongue, they really do stink. Five lots are required for Jackson the Cook.

Recovery Up (Japanese: , Kaifuku Appu) is a Gem in that increases the amount of HP recovered when being healed. This includes healing from Battle Arts, as well as healing from Riki's Yoink! Talent Art, Dunban's Critical Drain skill, and the gems Damage Heal, Aura Heal, Arts Heal, and HP Steal. __TOC__
Regal Daggers (Japanese: , Rīgarudagā) are weapons in . They are twin blades wielded by Fiora.
Rain Staves (Japanese: , Reinīsutaffu, Rainy Staff) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are staves that can be wielded by Melia.
Ranger Bottoms are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Reckless Zanden (Japanese: , Kokū no Zanden) is a quest exclusive Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Gogol family, and can be found at level 98 at the Arachno Queen's Nest in Tephra Cave during Battling Brutes and after the events at Mechonis Core (Chapter 17). Its nemesis, the Firework Geldesia which is an Arachno queen, can be found nearby. It can drop the Gogol Horns needed for A Token of Friendship and Colony 6 Reconstruction.

Ratio Glyphs are rare materials in . They can only be dropped by Unique Monsters between Levels 10 and 19, most of which are on the Bionis' Leg. According to their description, the truth of rationality is inscribed on them and like every glyph, they sell for a high price on the market.

Reflection (Japanese: , Rifurekushon) is one of Melia's support arts in and . It creates a reflective barrier, which can repel any attacks and debuffs except attacks from Talent Arts. The barrier lasts for five seconds.

The Rainbow Radiant is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is one of the four Radiants required for the Satorl Marsh quest Ancient Ceremony Offerings. It is found at the Altar of Fate in Satorl Marsh.

Reckless Galdon (Japanese: , Kūkyo no Garudēn) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Andos family. It can be found in the Hidden Warehouse in Tephra Cave, where it can be seen even before the area becomes accessible. Due to the area being closed off it cannot be engaged until after the events at Mechonis Core.

Ranger Tirkins (Japanese: , Renjā Tākin) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found from level 15-18 near Spiral Valley on Bionis' Leg. They can drop the Tirkin Tail Feathers needed for Material Quest 2.
Ravine Antols (Japanese: , Ravin Antoru) are enemies in . They are members of the Antol family, and can be found at level 18 near Daksha Shrine on Bionis' Leg.
Refined Ponytails are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found by defeating various Hodes, or by trading.
Red Wings are common materials in . They can be obtained from Sky Rhoguls and Drunk Vangs, or by trading with Nopo'rikh, Matryona, or Satata.
The Rear Entrance (Japanese: , Tefura Dōkutsu Uraguchi) is a landmark in . As its name implies, it acts as a rear entrance to Tephra Cave, leading to the Mag Mell Ruins. There are no enemies here.

Regal Pterix Wings are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Korlba Pterix and Illustrious Golteus in Makna Forest and Frenzied Bana in Frontier Village during Bana the Betrayer. Regal Pterix Wings are otherwise not available. According to their description, they come from a creature who ruled the skies and it is said that they can subdue storms.

Rainstorm Elements are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Aqua Nebulae in Satorl Marsh, or traded for with Talia during Talia's Research or Investigating Satorl. According to their description, they are water elements that can be thrown to bring a downpour within a three-meter radius.

Refined Parts S are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from various Mechon in Galahad Fortress and the Fallen Arm or traded for with Kazat. According to their description, they are pretty parts that are fun to just look at and they make great ornaments. Refined Parts L and Refined Parts M share this description.
Red Rhogul Wings are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are dropped by Sky Rhoguls or traded by Dulland.

The Rear Door Key is Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is found under a lone tree on the lower area along the west side of Exile Fortress. It can be used to open the back door of the Exile Fortress, allowing the party to rescue Kacha without being seen by the Ignas during Kacha's Kidnapping.

Recovery and Reflection (Japanese: , Fukkō no Kizashi to Senka no Kioku, Signs of Restoration and Memories of War's Flames) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located in Hope Farm in Colony 6, between Fiora and Dunban at purple affinity.
Reawakened Memories (Japanese: , Yomigaeru Kioku) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located on the diving platform on the seventh floor of Frontier Village, between Fiora and Sharla at purple affinity.

Rayguns are ranged weapons in . They are the ranged weapon for Enforcers, and can be further mastered by the Psycorruptor and Mastermind Classes. Rayguns are also the ranged weapons for Doug, Mia, Yelv, and Ga Jiarg.

Reclaimers is a division within BLADE. This division is known as Testament (Japanese: , Tesutamento) in the Japanese version. This division is dedicated to searching for and recovering of the White Whale scattered about Mira, and recovering lost items from the battlefield. Reclaimers receive increased Division Points from salvaging White Whale wreckage and planting Data Probes. Receiving division support from Reclaimers grants Drop Sensor, which increases chance of obtaining treasure from defeated enemies.

The Refugee Camp Shop is a shop in . It is located at the Refugee Camp on the Bionis' Leg. Many of Sharla's intermediate art books can be bought here. The shop adds a number of items after the story event battle at Spiral Valley. __TOC__ Note: In the following tables, "SV" refers to the story event battle at Spiral Valley.

Raguel Bridge - South (Japanese: , Ragueru Ōhashi Dai 1 Tō) is a landmark in . It is located at the south end of Raguel Bridge crossing Raguel Lake found on lower Bionis' Leg. In , a Nopon Assistant for the Nopon Grand Prix appears here after unlocking the Ether Jet and starting Chapter 6.
Recuperate is an Aura Battle Art in , and one of Cross' five signature arts. It increases evasion and gradually restores HP.

Regina is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Armory Alley in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. After Booming Business is completed, she can be found at the Cathedral in the Residential District.
The Raider Pugilith (Japanese: , Kyōshū-gata Berudero) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Pugilith and can be found at level 22 on Stoyanov Trail in Oblivia.
Raven Turbas (Japanese: , Reibun Kurekusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Turba family, and can be found at level 31-32, at the Turtle Nest in Primordia.

Recluse Mortifoles (Japanese: , Hidun Foriumu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Mortifole family, and can be found at level 25-29 at the canyon southwest of FN Site 318 in Oblivia.

Recluse Adseculas (Japanese: , Hidun Apisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Adsecula family, and can be found at level 21-26 at Aaroy Plain during the night, on the Leaning Ring, or at Central Ibra Ravine above Climati, the Chilling Wind in Oblivia.
Raijin is one of many Aura Arts in . It grants reflection of electric-attribute attacks, amongst other effects.
Reality Rift is one of many Debuff Arts in . It inflicts the debuff Slow Arts.
Raleigh (Japanese: , Rarī) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is located at Division Drive in the Administrative District. She is a member of the Pathfinders Division.

Reaver Auravises (Japanese: , Rīvu Akuira) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Auravis family, and can be found at level 31-34 or at level 38-39 in Primordia at FN Site 109. Two must be defeated to complete Plucking Auravises.
Rebel Queen Qmoevas (Japanese: , Reborutokuīn Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Qmoevas and can be found at level 41-50 in Primordia, south of FN Site 101.
Rebel Kaizer Qmoevas (Japanese: , Reborutokaizā Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Qmoevas and can be found at level 51-60 in Oblivia near FN Site 322.

Redsnake Pass (Japanese: , Akahebi Yamamichi) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a path located in Noctilum, between the Waterway Tangle and the upper entrance to the Whale's Weeper. It is inhabited only by Insidia.
Rainy Crickets (Japanese: , Reinīriokku) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum, in particular near Delusians South Summit.
Red Simius Manes are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Simiuses.
Red Blatta Wings are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red Blattas.

Recluse Thalluses (Japanese: , Hidun Aredare) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Thallus family. They can be found at level 22-28 at the Azure Lagoon or South Coast in Oblivia. Three of them must be defeated during Thinning the Thalluses.

Ramus, the Supersonic (Japanese: , Onsoku no Reimasu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Aetrygon family. It can be found at level 41 in the sky above northeastern Lake Ciel in Sylvalum. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Ramus, the Supersonic.

Rajidi, the Cumuliform (Japanese: , Sekiun no Rajidi) is a Tyrant in . It is a member of the Balaena family. It can be found at level 52 above the water south of FN Site 121 in Primordia, where it rarely replaces one of the Coral Balaenas.

Recluse Cantors (Japanese: , Hidun Imupureka, Hidden Cantor) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Cantor family, and can be found at level 51-59 at Delusians South Summit and Cavernous Abyss in Sylvalum.

Rapture Saltats (Japanese: , Rapuchā Sarutāto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Saltat family, and can be found at level 44-47 at Primeval Meadow and the Cryptic Sign in Oblivia.

Raven Blattas (Japanese: , Reibun Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 31-40 directly south of FN Site 210 in Noctilum. It appears between the cliff to the left and a plant.

Rain Scintimures (Japanese: , Rein Torizumo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scintimure family, and can be found at level 31-40 in Cauldros during electromagnetic storms, next to the beams connecting three of the Forgotten Mining Frigates above Dragonbone Promontory.

Red Vigent Rock Scalps are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red Vigents, or for 138 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Arts: Gain TP and Arts.GP augments.

Red Zone is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Full Metal Jaguar at rank 5. Cross and Celica can use this skill. The description does not mention it, but the skill also increases ranged and melee accuracy during Overdrive as well.
Red Thallus Antennae are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from reddish Thalluses in Oblivia. Two are required for Emotion Commotion.

Red Master Galdr (Japanese: , Reddomasutā Garudora) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Galdr machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and can be found at level 63 high above Anvil Sandplain, above Luxaar's Xern, in Sylvalum.
Rebel Oc-servs (Japanese: , Reburu Me-Tsuu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Oc-serv machines, and can be found at level 31-40 at the Cauldros Gate in Cauldros.

Reginal Plastrons are BLADE body armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are identical to the armor worn by Elma's true form, and only available through crafting. Colour variants are available in the Regal, Infinite, and True Plastrons, which are red, silver, and gold respectively. Crafting Requirements *Chapter 12 Completed * 5 Silver Yggralith Nuts * 10 Slimy Tongues * 10 Broken Pincers * 1 Cimmerian Cinnabar

Rebel Emperor Qmoevas (Japanese: , Reborutoenperā Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Qmoeva machines, and can be found at level 41-50, in the sky above Dragonbone Promontory in Cauldros.
Rapid Misfire (Japanese: , Ravubigguban, Love Big Bang) is an Affinity Mission in . It can be received in the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.
Reflect Damage Up is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It boosts reflect damage. The Skell equivalent is Reflect.DAMAGE-UP.
Raw Meaty Caecus Livers are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red Caecuses in Noctilum.

Reggie (English dub: ) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found near West Melville Street along with Bozé in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles. He and Clarissa are Bozé's students.

The Rectangular Chest is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is obtained in Sylvalum during the normal mission Lesson from the Grave. When the chest is opened, it is found to contain a book with the riddles from the three grave markers examined during the mission and their solution: * "Our treasure is bane to any wall,able to harm or heal one and all." * "Our treasure is succor to all of the poor,a flame that incinerates all evermore." * "Our treasure alone is fit to awakenthe way to a world that is long forsaken." * "That treasure is love—the light that shines our way even through the darkest of struggles. I record our love here, that we may never forget it. That we may use it a
Rainbow Metal is a unique material in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from Gadolinium Petramands and Praseodymium Petramands in Cauldros.
Red Filiavent Tentacles are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red Filiavents in Noctilum or Sylvalum.
Red Scintimure Tentacles are materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Scintimures in Noctilum or Cauldros.
Reclaiming the Whale is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Reclaimers and the primary destination is Oblivia.
Rainbow Wingtips is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the diner chef to obtain Multicolor Murra Wings in Cauldros.
Recycled Octopi is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a female mechanic and the primary destination is Cauldros.

Ranged Attack Probes are types of Data Probes in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They boost ranged attack of nearby party members and Skells. One can be received after completing every Story Mission. Another can be obtained as a reward from Hugo after completing Data Probe Breakthrough. The last one is located in an abandoned container at the Bandits' Refuge in Cauldros.

Rainbow Carving Shards are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained as rewards from missions featuring the Neilnail Albus and the Neilnail Furvus, or for 66 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Ranged Attack Drive augments.

Red Brandy is a rare material in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from yellow Arenatects, or for 90 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Extend Overdrive augments.

Red Forfex Shells are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red Forfexes, or for 36 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in Melee: Thermal Res Down, Nullify Thermal Reflect, Extend Thermal Res Down, and their Skell equivalent augments such as M-Auto.THERM-DOWN.

Red Milsaadi Hoods are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red-clothed Milsaadi, or for 42 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are a component in X, XV, and XX Ether Res Up and SpecUp.ETHER-RES augments.

Red Mortifole Feathers are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red Mortifoles in Oblivia, or for 66 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in I and V Overdrive: Gain TP augments.

Redwood Aprica Antlers are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red Apricas in Oblivia. Two are needed for Mayhem. They are used to craft Boost.HP-MAX Skell Frame augments.

Ralzes Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Grenada Galactic Group Dual Swords. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Insects category of the Cauldros Collectopedia. The Ralzes weapons available in-game are: * Archetype Ralzes * Iron Ralzes * Carbide Ralzes * Cermet Ralzes * Chrome Ralzes * Chromoly Ralzes * Cobalt Ralzes * Titanium Ralzes * Ceramic Ralzes * Diamond Ralzes

Raiding the Ganglion is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.9, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting twenty-four Quos. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Rampaging Cantors is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.12, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting fourteen Qmoevas. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Redesigned Tank Tops are casual torso armors made by Sakuraba Industries in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are available through several missions. All colors in this set have the same stats.
Rare Tank Tops are casual torso armors made by Sakuraba Industries in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are available through several missions. All colors in this set have the same stats.

Reckless Prone is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed, and is intended to make it easier to level up characters by earning EXP, Class EXP, and Battle Points. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Regal Comms are a BLADE head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are based on the armor worn by Elma's true form and are only available through crafting.
Regal Plastrons are BLADE body armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are based on the armor worn by Elma's true form and are only available through crafting.
Regal Cords are BLADE leg armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are based on the armor worn by Elma's true form, and are only available through crafting.
Regal Bangles L are a BLADE arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are based on the armor worn by Elma's true form, and are only available through crafting.
Regal Bangles R are a BLADE arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are based on the armor worn by Elma's true form, and are only available through crafting.
Rain Screen is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that nullifies the debuffs from rain weather.
Ranged Accuracy Drive is a ground armor Skell Augment in and that increases the Ranged Accuracy of the party member's Skell. Its effect caps at 100%.
Ranged Attack Drive is a ground armor Skell Augment in and that increases the ranged attack of the party member's Skell. Its effect caps at 100%.
Ranged Accuracy Up is a ground weapon stat Augment in and that increases ranged accuracy. The Skell equivalent is SpecUp.R-ACC.
Ranged Attack Up is a ground weapon stat Augment in and that increases ranged attack. The Skell equivalent is SpecUp.R-ATK.
Ranged Accuracy Boost is a ground weapon stat Augment in and that increases ranged accuracy by a percentage. The Skell equivalent is Boost.R-ACC.
Ranged Attack Boost is a ground weapon stat Augment in and that increases ranged attack by a percentage. The Skell equivalent is Boost.R-ATK.
Ranged: TP Gain Up is a ground weapon mod Augment in and that increases TP gain on ranged auto-attacks. The Skell equivalent is Custom.WP-R-GP.
Ranged Appendage Damage is a ground weapon special Augment in and . It increases damage dealt to enemy appendages from ranged attacks by 20% to 100%. The Skell equivalent is Crush.APPEND.
Ranged Draw Surge is a ground weapon Soul Voice augment in and . It increases the chance of triggering the Draw Ranged Soul Voice by 10% to 50%.

Reflect: Thermal is a ground armor augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Arts that grant reflect will also reflect thermal attacks. When equipped, this augment adds Thermal Reflection to reflection auras such as Supershield, Raijin, and Astrolibrium. This augment can be dropped by Dadaan, the Strongest Prone and cannot be crafted.

Reflect: Physical is a ground armor augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Arts that grant reflect will also reflect physical attacks. When equipped, this augment adds Physical Reflection to reflection auras such as Raijin and Astrolibrium. Supershield will not benefit from this augment as it already provides Physical Reflection. This augment can be dropped by Dadaan, the Strongest Prone and cannot be crafted.

Reflect: Electric is a ground armor augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Arts that grant reflect will also reflect electric attacks. When equipped, this augment adds Electrical Reflection to reflection auras such as Supershield and Astrolibrium. Raijin will not benefit from this augment as it already provides Electrical Reflection. This augment can be dropped by Lugalbanda, the Wanderer-King and cannot be crafted.

Reflect: Beam is a ground armor augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Arts that grant reflect will also reflect beam attacks. When equipped, this augment adds Beam Reflection to reflection auras such as Supershield and Raijin. Astrolibrium will not benefit from this augment as it already provides Beam Reflection. This augment is dropped by Lugalbanda, the Wanderer-King and cannot be crafted.

Razzlydazzly is an NPC in . He is a Nopon salvager who can be found at the Goldmouth Exit Dock in the Argentum Trade Guild. If spoken to after chapter 3, he will provide the Greedy Monster info item. Razzlydazzly offers no quests or Merc Missions.

Rankor Krabbles (Japanese: , Rekutā Kuraibu) are enemies in . They are members of the Krabble family, and can be found at level 1 - 3 in the Ancient Ship. Two can be found at level 1 around the Ancient Ship, Deck and one can be found at level 3 near the Ship Helm, all others are at level 2. These enemies drop no items.
Reedirait Bookstore (Japanese: , Hanamaru Shobō) is a shop in . It is run by Pelala and can be found at the Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild. It is specialized in Literature.
Raptor Raid (Japanese: , Raputāreido) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Megalance.
Raptor Beat (Japanese: , Raputābīto) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using Knuckle Claws.
Redemption (Japanese: , Ridenpushon) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Catalyst Scimitar.

Raider Igna (Japanese: , Reidā Igūna) are enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 33-37 in the Chansagh Wastes of the Empire of Mor Ardain. They are riding on Quake Rhinons.
The Refugee Campground (Japanese: , Nanmin Kyanpu-chi) is a Location in . It is located at Goetuis Port in the Indoline Praetorium.
Red Opal Lipsticks are Cosmetic Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Aquaneze Cosmetics in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Azami.

The Reedirait Deeds are a Store Deed key item in . They can be purchased from the Reedirait Bookstore in the Argentum Trade Guild after completing the Merc Missions Long-Awaited Work and Tome of Morytha Vol 2.
Rainbow Parfaits are Dessert Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Sprintsy Sweets in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Rapturous Scandia (Japanese: , Gokuraku no Sukanjinabia) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Taos family, and can be found at level 48 at the top of Godsford Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago. It can be reached by skip traveling to Lud Cloudway: Fonsett, then going down the slide towards Godsford Isle, jumping off the right side of the slide onto the platform, then climbing up the ivy to the top. Scandia needs to be defeated to unlock Agate's level 5 Heliodor Passion and Newt's level 5 Immolating Cleave affinity rewards.

Reeking Douglas (Japanese: , Akushūjū Benhā) is one of the Superbosses in . It is a Unique Monster and a member of the Rapchor family; it can be found at level 104 in the Brigands' Hideout in the Gormott Province after reaching the First Low Orbit Station. Douglas can summon level 66-108 Ground Caterpiles and level 74-95 Doryu Riiks as reinforcements when using its "Call Allies" art. Reeking Douglas has notably poor detection, and can be walked behind or nearby without attacking very easily.

Rebul Krabbles (Japanese: , Ribauto Kuraibu) are enemies in . They are members of the Krabble family and can be found at level 18-23 at the Cataracts of Rujah or Eight-Rock Skip in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Red Volffs (Japanese: , Reddo Vorufu) are enemies in . They are members of the Volff family and can be found at level 6-11 on the Plains of Evening Calm in the Gormott Province.

The Raqura Aquagardens (Japanese: , Rageruto Suichū Teien) are a Secret Area in . They are located in an isolated building in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya, connected to the outside only through an underground spring at the bottom of the stairs from the Ruins of Fountain Park. It requires level 3 "Water Mastery" and "Fortitude" Field Skills. It must be visited to unlock Azami's level 2 "Dark Mastery" Field Skill. There are no enemies here, although there are Treasure Troves and rare Collection Points.

|-|Lv. 91= |-|Lv. 36= The Rampaging Sauros (Japanese: , Satsuriku no Saurā) is a quest-exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Sauros family and must be fought at Sauros's Bed in the Gormott Province during Whereabouts Unknown, during which it replaces the Ancient Sauros normally found in the area. It is initially encountered at level 91, but if the party decides to retreat and then returns with a Benoît Nut to intoxicate it, the Sauros's level will be reduced to 36.

Rebra Flamiis (Japanese: , Rebura Furamī) are enemies in . They are members of the Flamii family and can be found at level 18-24 in the Kingdom of Uraya, particularly at the Cleansing Spring, Lake Varna, Eight-Rock Skip and Fonsa Myma Waters.
Razor Scouts (Japanese: , Reizā Sukauto) are enemies in . They are Ignas and can be found at level 74-76 in Badfella's Cave Fort in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya.
